Deepgram Voice AI offers multilingual speech-to-text (STT) capabilities on AWS Marketplace. The product listing at the provided URL (prodview-pnd4oy3p2xtro) enables quick deployment with usage-based pricing and consolidated AWS billing.[1]

## Key Features
Deepgram integrates with AWS services for scalable voice AI, supporting trials, POCs, and production use. It holds AWS Generative AI Competency status through a multi-year collaboration. Financing options like PNC Vendor Finance are available for eligible US customers.[1]

## Usage Benefits
Procure via AWS Marketplace for easy onboarding and alignment with AWS commitments. Reviews and additional details are accessible on dedicated AWS pages. Global scale and first-class integrations make it suitable for enterprise needs.[2][1]
